headline: A 2016 law renames the VA community clinic in Pueblo, Colorado, after Army Private First Class James Dunn.
what_it_does: This law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Pueblo, Colorado, the "PFC James Dunn VA Clinic." It is a naming measure only. It does not change the clinic's services, staffing, funding, or hours.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 7, 2016, and the new name took effect on that date.
